Name: Berry Woods
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
About two years ago I had the thought of just how annoying I found it to be running around the valley when it was berry season.

When I play (ESPECIALLY with mods) I have a lot to do. Berries are important, but I hated having to spend an entire day running around to do it.

So I had the goal of making a mod that added a 'grove' full of berry bushes to the game, so that there were a bunch of bushes centralized in one location and I didn't have to spend the whole day getting berries that felt essential to all of my plans. 

And I finally did it!

Now you too can have a lovely little grove full of bushes in the wonderful world of Stardew Valley!

You can find how to get there in the images section

Monsters and foragables can be toggled via the config - again I highly suggest using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to do this as it will make it far easier.


[center][b][u]﻿[/u][/b][b][u]Mod Notes (spoilers):
[/u][/b]
[spoiler] - Seasonal foragables will spawn every day, they get removed every 7 days
- Monsters are daily spawns, and include wilderness golems, green slimes, and blue slimes
- The stumps should respawn daily much like the ones in the secret woods
- In order to get into the berry grove you need to have an upgraded pickaxe, as well as the upgraded axe to get into the secret woods [/spoiler]
﻿﻿[/center]
[b][u][center]Mod Compatibility:[/center][/u][/b][center]﻿[/center][center]- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿
- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15041]Secret Woods Extra Area
[/url]- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url]﻿﻿
- Other Mods: Anything else that edits the secret woods may not be compatible, but I can create a compatibility patch if needed.﻿[/center]

[center][b][u]Misc Info:[/u][/b]
 I highly recommend using the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url] and other mods that require it for more berries - such as [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15893]Seasonal Berries[/url]﻿﻿[/center]

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b] 

[i]Thanks so much to[url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter/about-me?gameId=1303] FlashShifter[/url] for help figuring out what the heck I was doing wrong while making this, McJoseph for doing some testing for me to make sure everything I was doing was working (and to find all of the things my eyes missed), and to [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jayjaydub911/about-me?gameId=1303]JayJayDub[/url]﻿ for just being generally supportive of my mod making, they've known of this for the last two years and have encouraged me to do it :][/i]
